text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while out and about with Inari 
One—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Oh. Well look at that, ain't that the 
'Paka Petit' I've been hearing about?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking where Inari One pointed, there was 
a claw machine filled with plushies 
modeled after Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
They all have such charming faces. I'd 
love to scoop one up, but—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately, I'm not used to games like 
this. Though I'm quite the pro at festival 
yo-yo balloon fishing.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Ho! Boss, you're full of spirit! Does that 
mean you're confident you can win it?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Ho! Big Sis, you're full of spirit! Does 
that mean you're confident you can win it?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let's see what you've got. I 
have high expectations!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
